review_reference: Owner decisions in chat by D-Eminence, relayed by the coordinator, for 0122 (collect the sign-up fields): "don't remove them instead we need to collect those information" and "allow trading name, all fields required". Every field of facility sign-up, the setup wizard and staff patient registration is required on the website, except the three document uploads (operating licence, CAC certificate, proof of address) and the facility logo, which stay deferred until the document bucket and its scanner exist. The other decisions take the plan's recommended defaults: D1 CAC legal name kept, trading name collected; D2 the directory keeps the registered address; D3 E.164 8-15 digits, facility_alert_phones not seeded; D4 Medical Director name and MDCN collected, the applicant's phone stored encrypted; D6 state from the 37, LGA free text required; D7 departments a fixed code list; D8 the facility administrator edits after activation at self-service facilities; D9 sealed demo facilities refused; D10 the desk's patient phone and address facility-held, unverified, encrypted; D11 allergies not collected at the desk; D12 provisional local identity off; D13 a stated Health ID is a hint only: it never adds a review candidate (review finding: that would show staff a patient who gave the facility no consent and make a typo linkable); it marks with stated_hid a patient who is already a candidate by name and date of birth, and link-existing refuses a candidate whose only reason is stated_hid. RELEASE ORDER (review finding): the new sign-up and desk fields are optional in the API, all or none, so the live website keeps working: 1. this backend, 2. the website that always sends the fields, 3. a follow-up backend release that makes them required. UNSIGNED: reviewed_by stays empty until the owner signs.
evidence: Single migration 0122_collect_signup_fields.sql. WHAT IT DOES: new tables identity.nigeria_states (37 rows), identity.facility_profiles, identity.registration_case_contacts and identity.patient_facility_contacts (forced row-level security); identity.registration_cases is not altered; a new 11-argument identity.begin_self_service_provider_enrollment beside 0086's 7-argument one (unchanged, still granted); an AFTER UPDATE OF status trigger on identity.organization_applications that copies the confirmed code's profile to the facility on approval (self-service activation and administrator approval); identity.read_facility_profile() and identity.set_facility_profile(bigint,jsonb,text,char) (workforce.manage, self-service facility, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, audit with field names only). DELETION RULE (NDPA, 0084's rule): the desk's encrypted phone and address and the stated Health ID (identity.registration_case_contacts) and every facility's copy (identity.patient_facility_contacts) are never deleted and never changed except by erasure, which sets the ciphertexts, key version and stated Health ID to null and records erased_at and erasure_reason (a guard trigger allows nothing else, once). Erasure is the owner-only identity.erase_patient_facility_contacts(uuid,text) (no runtime grant; audited with counts only): an AFTER UPDATE OF state trigger on identity.patient_account_deletion_requests calls it when an account deletion completes ('account_deleted'), and Health ID support has it run through the owner for an NDPA erasure request ('erasure_request'). A case that never resolved to a patient keeps its contact with the case. No existing function body, policy or grant is replaced. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: no existing table gains a column; today's Identity calls the 7-argument command and never reads the new objects; the new Identity accepts the old sign-up and desk bodies (new fields all or none). PROOF: applied on a fresh throwaway Postgres 16 database after 0001-0108, runtime roles bootstrapped and verified; all 82 DB suites pass, including services/ehr-api/test/database/collect-signup-fields.integration.sql (erasure, guard and account-deletion cases) and patient-account-deletion; verify-order-routes-runtime.mjs and verify-records-processing-runtime.mjs pass on a loopback copy with the new sign-up fields and check the activated facility's profile.
